name: Poznan University of Technology
summary: Poznan's technical university, over a century old, on a riverside campus by the Warta; ten English-taught BSc degrees, free for EU citizens.

ib.text: Ranked on IB Maths plus the best science, out of 1,000 points; HL scores more (HL 7 = 200, SL 7 = 100) and 200 points are needed. The IB Diploma covers English and needs no NAWA recognition.

lastYear.text: register and upload documents 12 May–9 July

programmes.name: Architecture
programmes.about: Four-year engineering degree in architectural and urban design, taught by practising architects: technical drawing, designing buildings and organising space, with a focus on healthcare design, energy-efficient buildings and heritage.
programmes.ib: Upload a portfolio of up to eight drawings, including three pencil drawings on set themes (a figure in space, local architecture, a composition), when you apply.

needs.note: Scored ×1.5 in the ranking: HL 7 = 200 points, SL 7 = 100.

programmes.selectionNote: Portfolio worth up to 500 points plus IB Maths and Language A; 200 of 1,000 needed. 2026 criteria and places; 2027 not yet published.

programmes.name: Artificial Intelligence

notes: EU/EEA/Swiss citizens pay no tuition: upload your EU passport or ID as the fee-waiver document in the application; the €1,850–2,460 first-semester fees on the fees page are the non-EU price.

A PUT notice exempted IB holders from the online entrance exam, but the current step-by-step page mentions one for everyone except Architecture: ask the International Relations Office which applies to you.
One application can list up to three programmes in order of preference; you are admitted to the highest one you rank high enough for.
